pages.text: File $(l)world/serverconfig/rpmedicine-server.toml$() — every number of the mod, commented in Russian. In this book config values are $(cfg)coloured$() — the defaults are shown.

Main ones:$(br)- $(l)no_death_mode$() — no death (testing).$(br)- $(l)minigames_enabled$(), $(l)minigames_in_combat$() (minigames in combat too: $(cfg)true$()).$(br)- $(l)bleed_multiplier$(), $(l)pain_multiplier$(), $(l)heal_speed_multiplier$().

- $(l)knockdown_min/max_seconds$() — knockdown timer.$(br)- $(l)dosing_min_level$(), $(l)numbers_min_level$(), $(l)lab_min_level$().$(br)- $(l)iv_hose_length$() — IV hose.$(br)- $(l)book_skill_gating$() — this book's sections by Medicine level ($(cfg)false$() — everything for everyone).
- $(l)organs_enabled$(), $(l)infection_enabled$(), $(l)nutrition_enabled$(), $(l)substances_enabled$() — systems that can be switched off.
